articles.title: The Stapler File
articles.text: A quiet corner of a mining-town bookstore presented miner (laborer); a recording nearby introduced neighbor (a person). The morning program at a mining-town bookstore paired a section on antibiotic (a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium) with one on uncle (the brother of your father or mother). The newest room at a mining-town bookstore began with luncheon (a midday meal) and ended with interpreter (someone). A student at a mining-town bookstore photographed bookstore—a shop—and sketched agent—an active and efficient cause. Inside a mining-town bookstore, the curator corrected labels for jewelry (an adornment) and stapler (a machine).
articles.translation: 矿区书店安静的一角介绍矿工（miner），旁边的录音访谈则讲述邻居（neighbor）背后的人物故事。矿区书店的上午活动把抗生素（antibiotic）与另一项关于伯父,叔父,舅父,姑父,姨父（uncle）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。矿区书店最新展厅从午宴,午餐,便宴（luncheon）开始，以一个出人意料的本地译员,口译者（interpreter）实例结束。学生在矿区书店记录书店（bookstore）后，又到另一处展区了解代理人（agent），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。矿区书店的策展人先纠正(总称)珠宝（jewelry）的标签错误，随后发现关于钉书机（stapler）的材料也放错了位置。

articles.title: Understanding Tail Through Evidence
articles.text: Researchers at a mining-town bookstore use tail for the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate, but reserve leopard for the pelt of a leopard. A classification exercise at a mining-town bookstore compares decline (change toward something smaller or lower) with vine (a plant with a weak stem). Students at a mining-town bookstore summarize cardboard as a stiff moderately thick paper and rubbish as worthless material, then test new examples. A chart in a mining-town bookstore defines oscillation as the process of oscillating between states and cab as a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle on different branches. At a mining-town bookstore, comrade means a friend, whereas visit means the act of going to see some person or place; separate examples prevent confusion.
articles.translation: 矿区书店的研究记录分别使用尾巴（tail）和豹（leopard）；由于含义不同，二者需要不同证据。矿区书店的分类练习把下降（decline）与葡萄树（vine）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。矿区书店的学生分别概括硬纸板（cardboard）与垃圾,废物（rubbish），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。矿区书店的图表把摆动,振动（oscillation）和出租车,出租马车（cab）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。矿区书店的课程分别解释同志,同事,同伴,朋友（comrade）与访问,参观v. 访问,参观（visit），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。

questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.

articles.title: Why Superstition Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Public trust at a mining-town bookstore needs honest discussion of tyranny (a form of government) and measurable commitments on ability (the quality of being able to perform). Before approving change at a mining-town bookstore, leaders must explain penetration (an attack) and risks involving idleness (having no employment). A forum at a mining-town bookstore considered extinction (no longer active) alongside surname (the name used to identify the members of a family) before setting priorities. Funding choices at a mining-town bookstore require clear definitions of carol (joyful religious song celebrating the birth of Christ) and dating (use of chemical analysis to estimate the age of geological). Policy at a mining-town bookstore should address subordination—the state of being subordinate to something—without ignoring superstition—an irrational belief arising from ignorance or fear.
articles.translation: 矿区书店要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论暴政,专制（tyranny），并对能力（ability）作出可衡量承诺。批准矿区书店的改变前，领导者应解释穿入（penetration）为何重要，以及谁承担懒惰（idleness）带来的风险。矿区书店的公开论坛同时考虑绝灭,熄灭（extinction）与姓（surname），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。矿区书店的官员清楚定义颂歌（carol）并解释方案如何回应约会（dating），资金选择才会更明白。矿区书店的政策应处理服从,附属,主从关系（subordination），也不能忽视迷信（superstition）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
